bibl.title: A Study on the Monumental Center of Ancient Alexandria: The Identification of the Ptolemaic Mouseion and the Urban Transformation in Late Antiquity.
bibl.seg: Theodoros Mavrojannis, A Study on the Monumental Center of Ancient Alexandria: The Identification of the Ptolemaic Mouseion and the Urban Transformation in Late Antiquity.
bibl.note: The description of Alexandria by Strabo. - The location and the measurements of the gymnasium of Alexandria. - The four-porticated areas Strabo intended for temene. - The "center of the town" of Alexandria. - The verification of the topographical system. - The location of the Ptolemaic Museum and the "Temenos of the Muses" in Kom el-Dikka in the 5th century. - The topographical testimony of Pseudo-Callisthenes. - The Aspendia Plateia: The Lykeion-Mouseion and the Ptolemies as Argeadai and descendants of Danaus.
